items.stem: At strategic level, a board-facing case answer is strongest when it:

options.text: Integrates strategy, risk and financial-strategy issues into clear recommendations
options.rationale: Correct: strategic cases reward integrated, decision-focused advice to the board.

options.text: Lists strategic models without applying them
options.rationale: Unapplied models earn little; application to the scenario earns marks.

options.text: Focuses only on detailed bookkeeping entries
options.rationale: Strategic level is about direction and decisions, not bookkeeping detail.
A board expects a reasoned recommendation.

items.explanation: Correct: strategic cases reward integrated, decision-focused advice to the board.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A strategic case presents an acquisition opportunity with strategic fit but financing strain. The best structured response is to:

options.text: Weigh the strategic benefits against the financing risk and give a conditional recommendation
options.rationale: Correct: balancing benefit and financing risk with conditions is the strongest board-level answer.

options.text: Recommend the acquisition regardless of financing
options.rationale: Ignoring financing strain gives unbalanced advice.

options.text: Reject it purely because financing is tight
options.rationale: Rejecting on financing alone ignores the strategic fit and alternatives.

options.text: Leave the decision entirely to shareholders without analysis
options.rationale: The case requires the finance leader's reasoned analysis.

items.explanation: Correct: balancing benefit and financing risk with conditions is the strongest board-level answer.

options.rationale: Correct: scenario-grounded reasoning earns application marks.
